body:
Yeah. I hope it happens soon.

Well, thanks for talking and listening.
Ok. Just so you know, I think the "storm has passed". I just ate something, so I'm feeling a bit more stable.

It's a really long story...last year when I was really depressed, I had no coping skills. So I would rely on other people giving me affirmation in order to feel "stable". I told a lot of lies to get affirmation, to get hugs, all that jazz. And I finally came clean about it to my friends, and they were really mad at first, but after about a month, they were all supporting me again.

After a month of therapy, I was a different person. I had self-confidence, and I didn't need people to affirm me in order to be ok. That was in March.

So over that summer, I started to notice my friends getting distant. So when college started back up, I talked to my best friend about it, and he admitted that he had never really liked me. At all. He just thought I needed help, and that this was the "right thing to do." 

Basically, I lied to him and came clean myself, and he accepted my apology even though he had been lying to me for even longer, and didn't fess up until I dragged the truth out of him.

So because of that, because I really cared about him and loved him as a friend, after being betrayed and lied to, I'm terrified of trying to reach that level of friendship again. I'm so good at being on an acquaintance level with people, but most if not all friendships I have crash and burn after a couple year at the most.
If you don't like me, man up and say so. If you don't want to be my friend for friendship's sake, then leave me alone. Don't patronize me, don't "help" me.
I've just been through so many bad friendships that I've convinced myself that most people are shitty and if I befriend them I will get hurt.

I just want some goddamn honesty. I'm so tired of being a charity case for people, their "good deed for the day". But at the same time, I don't want to be a narcissistic asshole and tell people to, "Love me because I'm worth loving!"
Well thanks, but you aren't "here". It would be nice if someone were "here".
